name: Avius Animus
bio:
Avius Animus is a highly accomplished tattoo artist, specializing in geometric, fine line, and minimalist designs. Since embarking on their professional journey in 2015, Avius has consistently maintained a reputation for immaculate cleanliness in their practice, a standard that is evident in their current residency at FTC Bordeaux, France. Clients commend the hygienic environment and the thorough sterilization processes Avius adheres to, ensuring both artistry and safety are held in the highest regard.
